extracted.intended_audience: Authors of systematic reviews and meta-analyses (researchers, journal editors, evidence synthesis teams)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for authors on how to completely and transparently report systematic reviews and meta-analyses (primarily those evaluating effects of interventions), including which PRISMA documents and extensions to use.

rubrics_metrics.name: Complete reporting: rationale (why the review was done)
rubrics_metrics.description: Authors should completely report why a systematic review was done — the rationale and objectives motivating the review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: PRISMA provides guidance and examples to help authors completely report why a review was done. See the PRISMA Checklist, Expanded checklist, Statement paper, and Explanation and Elaboration paper for examples and elaboration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Complete reporting: methods used
rubrics_metrics.description: Authors should completely report what methods were used in the systematic review (search strategy, eligibility criteria, data collection and analysis methods, risk-of-bias assessment, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: PRISMA 2020 provides detailed guidance and examples for reporting methods. Use the Checklist and Expanded checklist to ensure all methodological items are reported; consult the Explanation and Elaboration paper for examples and rationale.

rubrics_metrics.name: Complete reporting: results found
rubrics_metrics.description: Authors should completely report what results were found by the systematic review, including study selection, study characteristics, syntheses, and conclusions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the PRISMA Flow Diagram to transparently report study selection and document results. The Checklist and Explanation and Elaboration paper provide item-level guidance and worked examples for reporting results.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use PRISMA 2020 for intervention-effect systematic reviews
rubrics_metrics.description: PRISMA 2020 primarily provides guidance for reporting systematic reviews evaluating the effects of interventions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When the review evaluates effects of interventions, follow PRISMA 2020 guidance (Checklist, Flow diagram, Statement paper, Explanation and Elaboration). The PRISMA 2020 materials are the primary documents for intervention-effect reviews.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use appropriate PRISMA extensions for other review types or aspects
rubrics_metrics.description: For different types or specific aspects of systematic reviews and other evidence syntheses (e.g., scoping reviews), use the relevant PRISMA extensions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: PRISMA extensions provide tailored reporting guidance for different review types and specialized topics. Identify and apply the extension most appropriate to the review type (for example, a scoping-review extension) in addition to or instead of the core PRISMA 2020 items.
